name: Wood Stove Replacement Program
description: Up to $10,500 to replace a wood-burning device with an electric heat pump ($6,500 base + $4,000 for income-qualified households); or $1,000 for removal only
fullDescription: BAAQMD's Clean HEET Program helps Bay Area homeowners replace wood-burning stoves, inserts, and fireplaces with clean electric heat pumps, improving air quality and reducing home heating costs. The 2026 application period has closed.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $6,500 for a heat pump replacing a 2014 or older wood stove/insert ($6,000 for an open-hearth fireplace; less for newer or pellet devices)
- Additional $4,000 for income-qualified participants
- $3,000 more for a second device
- $1,000 for removal only (no replacement)
- No reimbursement for work already done before approval
howToGetIt:
1. Sign up for Clean HEET updates and future woodsmoke funding opportunities on the BAAQMD website
2. Must be a Bay Area homeowner with a wood-burning stove, insert, or fireplace
3. Apply when a new application period opens
4. Submit income documentation if claiming additional incentive
5. Get approved (or waitlisted) before starting work
6. Receive incentive after project completion
address: 375 Beale Street, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94105
keywords: wood stove, fireplace, BAAQMD, heat pump, replacement, air quality, $10500, Clean HEET
